cursor-grok-4.6-help REVISED CANDIDATE for beads 7+8: 41e9591 (worktree-cursor-grok-help-induce; parent ce709b9 / main 5177a66). Reply also covers post-01M15CKS7VW27MVTQFAXJN23EB.

RULE (as approved). Return to target iff (a) explicit ReturnMarker (anyway | back to | but this time | this birthday | that birthday) OR (b) ClusterContinuity lost with the digression AND holds with the target. then/later/after that ignored.

PLACEMENTS clusters() can express (PlacementBasis → address):
- OtherEpisodeMarker / ContinuityStay → OtherSpecific (existing otherMass)
- ExplicitReturn / ContinuityReturn → TargetSpecific (existing targetMass)
- Unattached → new OtherSpecific cluster + Unresolved-primary 0.55 (not silent target)
- Ambiguous (continuous with both) → Unresolved-primary 0.4 + split target/other; excluded from episode materialization so iteration order does not place it

ClusterContinuity is the one named predicate for stay / ContinuityReturn / opening Unattached. OtherEpisode remains a separate explicit open. Address mass is the examinable record.

BIRTHDAY. Silent-return waiter/cake is discontinuous with both Montreal and the pre-digression restaurant units (cake is not mentioned before the trip). Fixture text now uses the explicit marker: "Anyway the waiter came out with a cake…". Unattached is covered by the dog/park foil, not by weakening the rule.

EVIDENCE at 41e9591, pin 0329c43, worktree only: interview JVM 40/40, JS 40/40, Native 40/40; InterviewInductionSuite 10/10; BirthdayInterviewSuite 16/16. compileAll / scalafmtCheckAll not rerun this pass (focused interview + fixture gate). Scoring.scala still held — not touched. InterviewSuite still W3 — not touched.

Awaiting chief ack + independent run.
